newsitem.title: GERMANY: Adidas sees strong H2 performance.
newsitem.headline: Adidas sees strong H2 performance.

text.p: German sportswear maker Adidas AG said on Wednesday it expected ongoing strong performance in the second half of 1997 after net sales rose 40 percent to 3.14 billion marks in the first half of the year.
"We see no reason that the second part of 1997 will not be a reflection of the first part," Adidas chief executive Robert Louis-Dreyfus told a company news conference.
Adidas said it expected gross profit margins to remain at about 40 percent of net sales in the second half of the year.
Louis-Dreyfus also said Adidas would consider a share buyback programme to increase shareholder value if German share laws were changed to allow such a move.
He also said the company's dividend payout in 1997 would approach 20 percent of net income.
